comparisons.peer_summary: The Board of Directors and its committees provide oversight of senior management's efforts to mitigate cybersecurity risk and respond to incidents. The Board includes members with specific cybersecurity expertise.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Citigroup (C) explicitly state that their Board of Directors and its committees provide oversight of senior management's cybersecurity efforts. However, MS specifies that this occurs under the oversight of the Board and the 'BOTC' (Board of Directors Technology Committee, implied by context of taxonomies and typical banking structures, though text says 'BOTC'), whereas C details that its Board includes members with specific cybersecurity expertise to facilitate this oversight.

sentences.text: We have made and continue to make substantial investments in cybersecurity and fraud prevention technology, and employ experienced talent to lead our Cybersecurity and Information Security organizations and program under the oversight of the Board and the BOTC.
Citigroup's Board of Directors and its committees provide oversight of senior management's efforts to mitigate cybersecurity risk and respond to cybersecurity incidents.

comparisons.peer_summary: Goldman Sachs administers its Information Security and Cybersecurity Program through Technology Risk within Engineering, with oversight provided by the CISO and an independent Operational Risk team that reports to the chief risk officer. The program is periodically reviewed to respond to changing threats.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Goldman Sachs (GS) describe a structured governance model for cybersecurity under Board oversight. MS highlights the role of experienced talent leading these organizations under Board and BOTC oversight. GS provides more structural detail, noting that its Cybersecurity Program is administered by Technology Risk and overseen by the CISO, with an independent Operational Risk team providing oversight and challenge, all within the firm's overall risk management framework.

sentences.text: We have made and continue to make substantial investments in cybersecurity and fraud prevention technology, and employ experienced talent to lead our Cybersecurity and Information Security organizations and program under the oversight of the Board and the BOTC.

Our cybersecurity risk management processes are integrated into our overall risk management processes described in the "Overview and Structure of Risk Management." We have established an Information Security and Cybersecurity Program (the Cybersecurity Program), administered by Technology Risk within Engineering, and overseen by our CISO.

A dedicated Operational Risk team, which reports to the chief risk officer, provides oversight and challenge of the Cybersecurity Program, independent of Technology Risk, and assesses the operating effectiveness of the program against industry standard frameworks and Board risk appetite-approved operational risk limits and thresholds.

comparisons.peer_topic: Board and Committee Oversight of Cybersecurity
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, CISO, and senior CTOC members concerning cybersecurity matters, including developments, policies, initiatives, and significant incidents. The Audit Committee and Risk Committee assist the Board in this oversight, while the Global Technology Operating Committee (GTOC) governs the Firmwide Global Technology organization and resolves key operational risk matters.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPMorgan Chase (JPM) disclose that the Board of Directors receives updates on cybersecurity matters. MS states that experienced talent leads the programs under the oversight of the Board and BOTC. JPM specifies that the Board receives periodic updates from the CIO, CISO, and senior CTOC members regarding developments, policies, and incidents, with the Audit and Risk Committees assisting in this oversight.

sentences.text: We have made and continue to make substantial investments in cybersecurity and fraud prevention technology, and employ experienced talent to lead our Cybersecurity and Information Security organizations and program under the oversight of the Board and the BOTC.

As part of its oversight of management's implementation and maintenance of the Firm's risk management framework, the Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, the CISO and senior members of the CTOC concerning cybersecurity matters.
The Audit Committee and the Risk Committee assist the Board in this oversight.
